name: Phantasmal Amputation
description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Ioseff holds up the stump of his left arm, and the streaming blood begins to form a ghostly hand that he then uses to point out a humanoid creature within 30 feet. That creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|traits:necromancy,occult] save.

Critical Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 1} by a sudden, agonizing pain in their left hand.

Success As critical success, but the creature also takes @Damage[2d6[slashing]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round as they feel as if their left hand just got lopped off by a hatchet.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 2}, takes @Damage[5d6[slashing]] damage, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute as they feel as if their left hand just got lopped off by a hatchet.

Critical Failure The PC is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 3} and takes @Damage[8d6[slashing],2d6[bleed]]{8d6 slashing damage and 2d6 bleed damage} as their left hand appears to detach and fall to the floor before instantly decaying into bones. The PC is clumsy 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Wounded]{Wounded 1}. As soon as this wounded condition is removed, the PC's hand miraculously returns and the clumsy condition ends.
